description.plain_text: @i;GeoPoints@n; creates a Points primitive from geometry, particles, deep image or image input. 'src' input can connect to a 3D geo source, Particles, a 2D flat-image source, or a 2-1/2D deep-image source. For image sources, the 'cam' input connects to a Camera node and provides the projection to reverse-project 2D pixels back into 3D scene space. Requires Z depth channel if image is flat (ie not deep). If the Surface Point channels is set, the camera is ignored and point positions are taken from the given channel. For geometry sources, the point positions come from the input vertices. For particle sources, the point positions come from the input particles.
description.text:
@i;GeoPoints@n; creates a Points primitive from geometry, particles, deep image or image input.

'src' input can connect to a 3D geo source, Particles, a 2D flat-image source, or a 2-1/2D deep-image source.

For image sources, the 'cam' input connects to a Camera node and provides the projection to reverse-project 2D pixels back into 3D scene space. Requires Z depth channel if image is flat (ie not deep).
If the Surface Point channels is set, the camera is ignored and point positions are taken from the given channel.
For geometry sources, the point positions come from the input vertices.
For particle sources, the point positions come from the input particles.
